title: Wheel Throwing Basics
summary: Centre clay, pull a cylinder and finish your first bowl.
description: Two and a half hours at the wheel with a small group. You will learn wedging, centring, opening and pulling walls. Every student leaves with two pieces that we glaze and fire for you.

title: Handbuilding Evening
summary: Pinch, coil and slab: make a planter or a small vase without a wheel.
description: A relaxed evening session on the three core handbuilding techniques. No experience needed, aprons provided.

title: Glaze Chemistry Lab
summary: Test tiles, colour mixing and why glazes behave the way they do.
description: We mix and fire a set of test tiles together. You will understand cones, oxides and how to fix crawling and pinholing.

title: Trimming & Finishing
summary: Foot rings, handles and clean edges on leather-hard pieces.
description: Bring two pieces from a previous class or use ours. Focus on tools, timing and the small details that make work look professional.

title: Little Potters (ages 7-12)
summary: Play-based clay morning for kids, with a parent welcome to join.
description: Kids make a pinch pot animal and a small dish. Everything is non-toxic and washable.

title: Raku Firing Day
summary: Outdoor raku firing with reduction, smoke and crackle glazes.
description: For students who already throw or handbuild. Bring pre-bisqued pieces. Safety gear provided, expect to get a little smoky.

title: Date Night at the Wheel
summary: Two people, one wheel and a lot of laughing.
description: Price is per pair. A friendly intro to throwing with snacks included.

title: Figure Sculpting
summary: Build a hollow figure from a reference and learn to dry it safely.
description: Armatures, hollowing and joining. Class size is limited to six.
